_meta.purpose: Manually researched search-intent targeting per frozen slug, for ADDENDUM §14. Read by scripts/build-dua-pages.mjs, which uses titleOverride / descriptionOverride when present and otherwise falls back to the MASTER SPEC §5 default formulas.

rules.overridesAreTheException: Leave titleOverride and descriptionOverride null unless real keyword research exists for that page. The generated defaults are already collision-resolved against real corpus data.
rules.confidenceDefault: targetingConfidence defaults to "none". Only set "researched" when actual keyword data backs it. Never guess and then label it researched.
rules.uniquePrimaryQuery: primaryQuery must be unique across the corpus. Two frozen slugs targeting the same query is a consolidation signal under ADDENDUM §15, not something to resolve here.
rules.targetingOnly: secondaryQueries inform targeting only. They are never written into visible page copy, which stays governed by MASTER SPEC §8.
rules.noUnsupportedClaims: Never target a query the dua's verified data does not actually support.

_meta.status: EMPTY BY DESIGN as of 2026-07-31. No keyword research has been carried out for this corpus, so no entry may claim "researched". The builder's default title/lede/description formulas are in force for all 506 pages.
